basic_details.job_title: NABCONS Associate Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Two Associate Consultant posts, one in HR and one in Finance & Accounts, are open as Core Contract Staff at the Corporate Office, New Delhi of NABARD Consultancy Services (NABCONS), a wholly owned subsidiary of NABARD. Indian Citizens can apply only online through the post-wise application link from 2 November 2026 to 9 November 2026 (midnight).

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or a fixed remuneration amount.

rows.details: NABARD Consultancy Services (NABCONS), a wholly owned subsidiary of NABARD
Associate Consultant-HR; Associate Consultant – Finance & Accounts
Core Contract Staff; renewed annually based on performance
Consolidated monthly remuneration as per NABCONS Policy and Industry Standards

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NABCONS has advertised 02 posts of Associate Consultants as Core Contract Staff. The company reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts or not to fill up any of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Citizens may apply. The minimum educational criteria for each post are listed below. Experience: minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience handling HR matters in the HR department of an established organization/Public sector/Banking and Finance Sector. Good written and oral business communication skills and analytical skills. Should be a team player, energetic, with excellent presentation skills. Knowledge of practical use of tools such as MS Office, including advanced Excel features for day-to-day functioning. Problem-solving skills. An eye for accuracy and attention to detail. Experience: at least three years, post CA/CFA/ICWA/MBA-Finance/M.Com qualification, in Accounts, preparation of financial statements and Balance Sheet, direct and indirect taxation etc. in a reputed organisation. Work experience in various types of accounting software such as ERP, Tally etc. Proficiency in reading, writing and speaking in English and Hindi. Excellent knowledge of MS Office with proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint. An eye for accuracy and attention to detail. For both posts, the age is preferably below 35 years as on 31 October 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Regular Graduate in any subject with minimum 60% or equivalent grade points in CGPA from a reputed institution, and Regular MBA or PGDM or equivalent in HR with major subject as HR/Industrial relations from a reputed management institution with minimum 55% or equivalent grade points.

Bachelor of Commerce/Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) with minimum 60% or equivalent marks in CGPA from a reputed institution, and CA/CFA/ICWA/MBA-Finance/M.Com qualification having registration with ICAI/ICWA or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts carry a consolidated monthly remuneration "As per NABCONS Policy and Industry Standards". The remuneration would be considered based on relevant experience, qualification, last drawn salary etc. Tax is deducted at source as per the Income Tax Act and Rules in force. Besides the remuneration, the candidate is also eligible for other facilities/allowances as per NABCONS policy. The vacancy is for Core Contract Staff, who manage multiple assignments; their tenure of service is full-time in nature. Core Contract Staff are eligible for benefits such as Provident Fund, Gratuity, Leave Encashment and other benefits. The engagement would be continuous in nature and will be renewed annually based on performance. After completion of the first year, the contract will be renewed for another one year and then annually in a block of 3 years. Performance is reviewed quarterly in the first and second year of engagement, and annually in the following years. NABCONS may terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without giving any reason; in the normal course, it may terminate the engagement by giving one (01) month notice in advance within the contract period. Contractually engaged staff have no legal claim to regular absorption during or after the contract, and no claims as to seniority.

content_sections.heading: NABCONS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Manpower management, recruitments, hiring, empanelment, coordination with Zonal Offices and Regional Offices, terminations, HR compliances viz, PF, Gratuity, leave management, Performance management, renewal of contracts, training, Salary management and RTI replies etc. Implementation of HR policies, systems & processes in line with the aggressive growth strategy. Proficient in liaising with business and vertical heads along with employees at different levels to design and implement Talent Development Strategy. Possess expertise in identifying training needs across levels. Manage End to End Recruitment Cycle & Manpower Planning. Initiating various recruitment reports, analysis and dashboards and managing & delivering them on a periodic basis. Compliance of historical data for migration to new software. Absence Management. Administration and HR related data management procurement of dead stock items. To coordinate CSR activities of the company including project management. Develop programme, retention strategies and attrition management. Any other work as assigned from time to time. Maintenance of accounts. Preparation of Financial Statements. Preparation and review of budget estimates. Handling Accounting Software (ERP). Responsible for the monthly/quarterly/Annual closing as well as maintenance of all accounting ledgers, review of all account reconciliations/journal entries. Provide accurate, timely and relevant recording, reporting and analysis of financial information. Keeping account books and systems up to date. Complying to Statutory requirements and reporting to Credit Information Companies. Preparation of Bank Reconciliation statements. Computation and payment of applicable taxes e.g. GST, PF, TDS, Income Tax and filing of returns. Coordination for various types of audit, etc. Recording Receipts and Payments. Attend to work related to invoicing/income booking, review of sundry debtors. Managing staff/vendor payments, related entries in Bank Portal. Funds management and investment of surplus funds in various instruments, maintenance of records of investments. Any other matter/work assigned by the Management from time to time in line with the changing evolving business demands on an on-going basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABCONS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online, in the prescribed format, from 2 November 2026 to 9 November 2026 (midnight). Applications by hand or any other mode will not be entertained, and applications received after the due date will be rejected. Open the application link for the post you are applying for: Associate Consultant-HR – https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/9mMYzF5NkT ; Associate Consultant – Finance & Accounts – https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/T3N3VRzFLL . If the link does not open, copy and paste it into your web browser. Fill in the details in the online form. Give the declaration in the online form about your educational qualification and experience. Submit the form successfully; only applications submitted successfully will be considered. The notice also says candidates should apply only online through the NABCONS website ( www.nabcons.com ) or Naukri.com, and that no other mode of submission will be accepted. Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, to be compulsorily submitted at the time of the interview. Self-attested copies of experience certificates, to be compulsorily submitted at the time of the interview. Original documents for verification at the interview; a candidate without them will not be allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted as per the eligibility criteria may be subjected to a qualifying written test, if required, followed by a Personal Interview. Shortlisting: meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. NABCONS reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates, depending on the number of responses, after preliminary screening/shortlisting with reference to qualification, suitability, experience, etc. Written test: qualifying in nature and held only if required. Personal Interview: only shortlisted candidates will be called. The place, location and process of the interview will be indicated in the call letter. Any cost incurred for attending the interview will not be reimbursed by NABCONS. Eligibility is verified at the interview/joining stage, based on the information given in the online application. The final appointment will be based on the decision of the selection committee constituted for the purpose.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: NABCONS reserves the right to change these dates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 vacancies: 01 Associate Consultant-HR and 01 Associate Consultant – Finance & Accounts, both at the Corporate Office, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online applications is 09 November 2026 (midnight); applications open on 02 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NABCONS Associate Consultant-HR?
faq.answer: A regular graduate degree in any subject with minimum 60% and a regular MBA or PGDM or equivalent in HR (major in HR/Industrial relations) with minimum 55%, plus minimum 3 years of post-qualification HR experience.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for NABCONS Associate Consultant – Finance & Accounts?
faq.answer: B.Com/B.Com (Honours) with minimum 60% and CA/CFA/ICWA/MBA-Finance/M.Com with registration with ICAI/ICWA or equivalent, plus at least three years of experience in accounts after that qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age for both posts is preferably below 35 years as on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a NABCONS Associate Consultant?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is as per NABCONS Policy and Industry Standards, decided on relevant experience, qualification and last drawn salary, with other facilities/allowances as per NABCONS policy.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NABCONS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only through the post-wise form link given in the notice between 02 November 2026 and 09 November 2026; applications by hand or any other mode are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NABCONS Associate Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates may take a qualifying written test, if required, followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NABCONS Associate Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a Core Contract Staff engagement renewed annually based on performance, with no legal claim to regular absorption, though staff get Provident Fund, Gratuity and Leave Encashment.

faq.question: Q10. Will NABCONS pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No, any cost incurred for attending the interview will not be reimbursed by NABCONS.
